summary.intent: Improve spacing and readability in the memories tab UI, specifically the gap between filters and table headers, and the layout of the detail card.
summary.outcome: Added spacing between filter chips and table headers, improved detail card layout with blank lines between sections (title, metadata, body, why, stats), increased card padding from Padding(0,1) to Padding(1,2), and added a blank line between the title and metadata row. All changes committed.

repo: The memories tab TUI layout lives in cmd/entire/cli/memorylooptui/tab_memories.go
Detail card sections (title, metadata, body, why, stats) are rendered as a single string with newlines — spacing is controlled by inserting '\n\n' between sections
Card padding is set via a Padding(vertical, horizontal) call on the card style

code.finding:
Filter chips to table header gap was a single '
'; changed to '

' for visual separation
Detail card padding was Padding(0, 1); increased to Padding(1, 2) to add vertical breathing room inside the border

workflow: UI spacing issues were caught iteratively via screenshots — multiple rounds of small edits were needed rather than a single pass
Changes were batched into a single commit after all spacing iterations were complete

friction: Took three iterations to get detail card spacing right — initial fix didn't separate title from metadata, requiring a follow-up edit
